chapters.title: Chapter 1: Executive Summary & Corporate Qualifications
chapters.content:
PJMAK Company is pleased to present this comprehensive Technical and Commercial Proposal to the Orsted & Boskalis Subsea Consortium for the turnkey engineering, simulation, pull-in execution, and pre-commissioning of the 220kV HVAC Subsea Export Cable System.

Key Highlights:
• Proven methodology for North Sea dynamic seabed and trenching conditions.
• Turnkey engineering package including dynamic riser analyses, pull-in winch sizing, and route bathymetry surveys.
• ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and DNV-ST-N001 certified execution framework.
• Fixed-price commercial commitment of EUR 485,000 covering all primary engineering, vessel interface verification, and mobilization phases.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Scope of Work & Subsea Technical Methodology
chapters.content:
2.1 Cable Route Optimization & Metocean Assessment:
Detailed analysis of seabed geotechnical conditions, sand wave mobility, and hydrodynamic drag coefficients.

2.2 Subsea Pull-In & J-Tube Interface Engineering:
Rigging calculation, hold-back winch tensions, bellmouth entrance geometry, and seal assembly validation in accordance with client platform specifications.

2.3 Dynamic Cable Protection System (CPS) Installation Plan:
Polyurethane split-pipe articulated protectors and concrete mattress placement sequence at touchdown zones.

2.4 Post-Lay Inspection & Remote ROV Survey Validation:
Multibeam echosounder (MBES) verification and depth-of-lowering (DOL) acoustic survey protocol.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: HSE, Environmental Management & DNV Compliance
chapters.content:
3.1 Zero-Harm Marine Environmental Charter:
Strict adherence to North Sea maritime environmental directives, acoustic mammal monitoring during vessel positioning, and zero marine discharge.

3.2 Risk Assessments (HAZID & HAZOP Protocol):
Full hazard identification sessions covering vessel craneage, diver/ROV intervention, weather window limitations, and emergency cable abandonment procedures.

3.3 DNV-ST-N001 Marine Operations Compliance:
Third-party Marine Warranty Surveyor (MWS) certificate of approval will be coordinated for all seafastening and offshore rigging packages.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Commercial Pricing Breakdown & Milestone Schedule
chapters.content:
Commercial Schedule (Fixed-Fee Engineering & Operational Supervision):

• Milestone 1: Mobilization & Detailed Route Engineering — EUR 120,000 (Month 1)
• Milestone 2: Pull-In Spread Deployment & J-Tube Operations — EUR 215,000 (Month 2)
• Milestone 3: Fiber-Optic & High-Voltage Testing & Pre-Commissioning — EUR 150,000 (Month 3)

Total Contract Value: EUR 485,000 net.
Payment Terms: Net 30 days upon submission of milestone acceptance certificate.
Validity: 60 calendar days from date of issuance.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Clarifications, Commercial Acceptance & Questionnaire
chapters.content:
To complete the formal evaluation and commercial alignment for this proposal, please complete the official client evaluation questionnaire.

The questionnaire enables your engineering and procurement teams to confirm technical parameters, cable specifications, vessel availability windows, and formal commercial clarifications directly.

Please click "Open Questionnaire" below to access the secure form.
